_comment: Channels surfaced in the Pyaar Radio app's Channels tab. A channel is any [sync]-marked YT Music playlist you browse to explore (add songs to Liked). synced:true = auto-maintained: source 'pifyi'/'tempa' by this repo's sources framework (sources/sources.json); 'crate-maker' by the external Crate Maker agent (artist inspo sets). Add a row to register another.
